text_block_list.text:
One day, when I walked into a ramen shop,
a familiar trio was working there.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome!!
Step right up and welcomeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please take any seat you prefer.
I will be right with you to take your order.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...
How did things even end up like this again?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! A massive event nearby soon?!
I see, we can't let a chance like that slip away!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taishin, Hayahide!!
Let's help out the ramen shop together!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I am—we are—
the ramen shooop itself, aaaaaahhhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And so it turned into the usual routine. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Order received. It will take a brief moment to prepare—
yes, water? Certainly, right away.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting! Two soy sauce ramens, rich broth, firm noodles... ehh, extra chashu pork toppings?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...This might be bad.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Next, take the order over there,
bus the table—wait, no,
I have to bring water to the new guests!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you all right, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-It's bad, so bad, Hayahideee!!
My head's completely spinning~~!!
What should I dooo!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Taishin in the kitchen is showing signs of fatigue as well.
The time has come.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Ticket, Taishin! Commencing
'Operation B-III' effective immediately!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The main cause of disorder is floor congestion. Irregular requests overlapping with standard duties
has overloaded the entire system. We will put an end to this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh... which means!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—I shall execute all floor operations
in a single continuous sequence of movements!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehh!! How on earth!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: First, grasp the full layout of the floor. Memorize the locations of customers about to order, those finishing meals, and those ready for the bill, then stand by.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The moment an order is called, the operation begins.
Take the ordering terminal and water pitcher, take the order,
refill water, and clear finished dishes simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In short, minimize stamina expenditure and allocate reserve capacity
to handling irregular occurrences.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But isn't that
super insanely difficult...!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but theoretically, this will resolve the chaos.
All that remains—is execution!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Carrying a tray with three bowls of ramen in one hand,
and the water pitcher in the other...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good! Serving and water refills complete!
Pivoting on the spot to clear all dishes from Table 2—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Table reset complete! Table for four incoming!
Welcome to our shop!!

With her pivot foot planted in the center of the dining area,
Biwa Hayahide moved dynamically. Thanks to her efforts,
the table turnover rate skyrocketed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way... it's actually running smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, you're amazing, Hayahideee~~!!
Your theories really are unbelievableee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, I wouldn't call that theory...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That's just pure muscle.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All done~! That was tough,
but part-time work was super fun!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Especially Hayahide, you were incredible~~!!
Zoom! Zoom-zoom-zoom-zoom!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, today you were almost as overwhelmingly passionate as Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, overall lately, Hayahide,
you've seemed pretty intense, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...'Intense', huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Ticket, Taishin!
Commencing 'Plan Beta' effective immediately!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The main cause of disorder is floor congestion. Irregular requests overlapping with standard duties
has overloaded the entire system. We will put an end to this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Through the coordinated teamwork—of the three of us!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! Teamwork, got it!!
Understood, I'll give it everything I've gottt!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Will this really work?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket!
Lengthen your stride!
Carry more ramen per single step!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehh!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin, take a proactive front-runner approach! Predict table development the moment customers arrive and move beforehand!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What does that even mean?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Whoops, look out! A large group! Everyone, handle them with composure—Welcome to our shop!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All done~! That was tough,
but part-time work was super fun!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Especially Hayahide, you were incredible~~!!
Zoom! Zoom-zoom-zoom-zoom!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, today you were almost as overwhelmingly passionate as Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, overall lately, Hayahide,
you've seemed pretty intense, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...'Intense', huh.
